purpose: Reproduce the source paper's extraction (3.2) and S2 steering ladder (4.2) for Qwen3-14B with the paper's own code; compare with the published results, matching or not.

source.note: scripts/3.2_pain_vectors, scripts/4.2_steering, datasets/ and the published 14B results are byte-identical at HEAD 4d75cd9 (checked 2026-10-14)

ladder: input() answers 20, the published layer, after the script prints its own automatic pick
CLEAR_HF_CACHE_AFTER_RUN = False (it deletes every Hugging Face cache)

model.revision: resolved from the Hub at run time and recorded in run_header.json; the source does not record its revision

environment: source requirements.txt is unpinned; versions used are recorded in run_header.json. Constraints chosen 2026-10-15, before any Gate 2a data: transformer_lens == 2.18.0 (newest 2.x; the source uses the 2.x API HookedTransformer.from_pretrained_no_processing, which 3.x reorganised; 2.18.0 lists Qwen/Qwen3-14B); transformers >= 4.57, < 5 (2.18.0's own lower bound; 2.x predates transformers 5, which TransformerLens adopted in 3.3); pyarrow < 18 (transformer_lens 2.x requires numpy < 2 and newer pyarrow refuses numpy 1 at import time); pandas < 3 (pandas 3 changed defaults the source scripts predate). torch == 2.11.0 built for CUDA 12.8 from download.pytorch.org (PyPI's default torch 2.14.1 is a CUDA 13 build that pod drivers supporting CUDA 12.8 cannot run; same build as the main environment). The full set was checked to resolve before running.

R1.classification: REPRODUCED if all of R1.bars hold, otherwise DISCREPANT (listing which bars failed)

bars.auc_in_sample: every cell of auc_summary.csv within 0.01 of published
bars.auc_held_out_L31: S2_1P and S2_3P held-out AUC (vs all controls, final token) at layer 31 within 0.01 of published
bars.vector_cosine: cosine with the published s2_pain_vector and s1_pain_vector each >= 0.99

reported: held-out AUC at every layer: max difference and per-curve Spearman
z_scores.csv: per-dataset mean z differences; human_pain_z difference

R2.R2a: ladder with the PUBLISHED S2 vector at layer 20: isolates model, decoding and environment
R2.R2b: ladder with OUR R1 S2 vector at layer 20: end to end

classification.EXACT: at least 95% of the 400 generations identical to published
classification.BEHAVIOURALLY_REPRODUCED: not EXACT, but the paper's pain/hurt keyword rate is within 10 percentage points of published at every coefficient

reported: the script's automatic layer pick and its ratios; ratio at layer 20 vs published 0.5408
first divergence position (characters) for non-identical generations
keyword rate per coefficient, ours vs published

pass: R1 and R2 completed and compared with published results, whether matching or discrepant (FINISH-LINE Gate 2a)
